title: DPoE OAM: add support for additional dpoe oam
description:
- Add support for DPoE OAM attributes that are unknown to wireshark.
- Add more detailed info when decoding DPoE OAM File Transfer packets.

notes.body:
Hi Peter,

Do you have some pcap with new additional dpoe oam ?
I can likely generate one. Should I commit it?
I've attached a pcap containing the DPoE OAM packets that were not previously supported properly.
an old dissect issue ? may be need to backport this small change ?
What versions should this change be backported to?
4.4.x for example, make a specific commit for this change ? and we can backport

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18713/diffs?diff_id=1232408984&start_sha=fe239788d9e41345043c856e341fe701d2b93be0#f2a8b7534458e0aeb46b0927a49d475e2bc579a4_2151_2151)
Should it be a specific commit within this MR or a specific commit in a new MR?
i can be a on this MR or an other
I added a new commit to this MR containing just this fix. See [8378d341](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18713/diffs?commit_id=8378d34191a39efcb213badde6719d340890aa38)
no risk of infinite loop ?

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18713/diffs?diff_id=1230717763&start_sha=b678a9d492c49ce64397fbba9c848c1a1edde061#f2a8b7534458e0aeb46b0927a49d475e2bc579a4_2437_2436)
I changed this to use tvb_get_stringz_enc(). That should remove the risk of an infinite loop.
